title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  • the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  • the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament
  • efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich

Implement the Competitions project, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich

Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management

Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services

Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment

Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)

Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary

Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners

Overseeing the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;

Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil

Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.

Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team

Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):

  • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements
  • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines
  • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities
  • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties
  • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required
  • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops
  • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC

Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):

  • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management
  • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
  • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
  • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
  • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams - in the lead-up to the FWWC

YOUR PROFILE

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

description:
Job description

O Colégio Franco-Brasileiro tem como compromisso garantir uma educação de excelência, feita de maneira global, com base em uma formação socioemocional sólida.

Nosso principal objetivo é a formação integral dos nossos alunos, pois, além de garantir o ensino de excelência, temos também o compromisso de formar cidadãos com pensamento crítico, princípios éticos, capazes de desenvolver e repensar a realidade de hoje.

Vinculada à Coordenação Pedagógica, a Monitoria é um espaço em que estudantes com alguma dificuldade no processo de ensino-aprendizagem são atendidos, podendo tirar suas dúvidas, resolver exercícios, além de receber orientações de estudo.

A Monitoria também atende aos estudantes que desejam se aprofundar em seus estudos.

Main responsibilities

  • Prestar monitoria no Componente Curricular de Biologia;
  • Receber, atender e tirar dúvidas dos estudantes;
  • Estudar com os alunos e alunas;
  • Em parceria com a Coordenação Pedagógica e de Disciplina, acompanhar o desenvolvimento dos estudantes que buscam a Monitoria;
  • Elaborar relatórios sobre as atividades realizadas na Monitoria;
  • Desenvolver atividades de aprofundamento de estudos.

Requirements and skills

  • Estar cursando Ensino Superior (Licenciatura em Biologia);
  • Habilidade em comunicação.

Additional information

Tipo de contrato: CLT

Carga horária: 3 horas e 30 minutos (7 tempos de 30 minutos) no turno da tarde entre 13h30 às 18h a combinar

title: Supervisor de Sell Out SP - L'Oréal Luxo
description:
Missão do Cargo

Você será responsável pela supervisão, desenvolvimento e performance da nossa equipe de campo. Sua missão é garantir a excelência na execução dos pontos de venda (PDV), o atingimento das metas de sell out e o crescimento sustentável das nossas marcas icônicas nos clientes sob sua responsabilidade.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento: Liderar, acompanhar e desenvolver a equipe de consultores(as) de vendas através de visitas constantes a campo, orientações contínuas, feedbacks estruturados e avaliações de desempenho.
  • Gestão de Resultados: Elaborar, implementar e acompanhar planos de ação focados no atingimento das metas de sell out, produtividade e indicadores de performance (KPIs).
  • Excelência em Execução: Garantir o padrão de luxo nos PDVs, assegurando a correta exposição, estoque adequado, implementação de materiais de merchandising e total aderência às diretrizes das marcas.
  • Negociação Comercial: Realizar negociações de sell out com clientes e gestores de loja, buscando oportunidades de incremento de vendas, ações promocionais e fortalecimento do relacionamento comercial.
  • Análise e Reporting: Monitorar resultados, analisar indicadores e reportar o desempenho à gestão, propondo melhorias e ações corretivas sempre que necessário.
  • Interface Estratégica: Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas internas (Formação, Trade Marketing, Comercial e RH), garantindo alinhamento estratégico e execução eficiente.
  • Gestão de Gente: Conduzir processos de recrutamento, seleção, admissão e integração de novos colaboradores da equipe de campo, garantindo a manutenção do engajamento e do clima organizacional.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência: Vivência prévia com gestão de pessoas e liderança de times.
  • Vivência de Mercado: Experiência com PDVs multimarcas e negociação direta com lojas do segmento de beleza/luxo.
  • Habilidades: Forte capacidade de liderança, comunicação assertiva e análise crítica de resultados.
  • Mobilidade: Disponibilidade para visitas frequentes a campo e viagens esporádicas.

description:
SUPERVISOR(A) ASSISTENCIAL


Rio de Janeiro


#VemSerOC


Pioneiro no país em gestão de serviços oncológicos, a Oncoclinicas&Co foi fundada em 2010 e hoje é um dos maiores centros de oncologia, hematologia e radioterapia da América Latina.


Na essência da Oncoclinicas&Co, o paciente é o centro de tudo. É para ele que buscamos os mais avançados tratamentos e o mais alto nível de qualidade e segurança. Temos como pilares de atuação o acolhimento e a inovação no tratamento oncológico e a atenção integral e personalizada, com um olhar no indivíduo.


Aqui na OC valorizamos a diversidade e buscamos promover uma cultura inclusiva onde as pessoas se sintam pertencentes. Acreditamos que a inovação nasce de um ambiente diverso, com diferentes perspectivas e vivências.


O que você irá fazer:


Supervisor as atividades da equipe multidisciplinar, que contempla os serviços de nutrição, estomatologia, psicologia, assistência social e as rotinas ligadas ao comissionamento de transplante (TMO), conforme procedimentos e protocolos clínicos e hospitalares de rotina e/ou específicos, respeitando a legislação vigente e dentro dos critérios de qualidade e padronização da assistência prestada pelo Grupo. Responsável pelo atendimento diferenciado e humanizado aos pacientes oncológicos e oncohematologicos.


O que você precisa ter:



  • Superior Completo em Enfermagem, Nutrição ou Psicologia com registro ativo no respectivo órgão;

  • Especialização em Oncologia;

  • Experiência em ambulatório de Oncologia;

  • Pacote office.


Local e horário de trabalho:



  • Barra da Tijuca - Rio de Janeiro;

  • Segunda à Quinta de 08h00 às 18h00 e Sexta de 08h00 às 17h00.


O que oferecemos:


Pesando em seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos o PROGRAMA MAIS SABER – que proporciona descontos, conforme rede conveniada, em instituições de ensino superior e escolas de idiomas


Para contribuir com sua saúde mental, financeira, etc. oferecemos o DR. AON (APOIO AO COLABORADOR – uma central de saúde que oferece telepsicologia, orientação médica, nutricional, acompanhamento do pré-natal de gestantes e teleatendimento médico.


Somos uma empresa da área de saúde e preocupados em seu bem-estar, oferecemos o PLANO DE SAÚDE e o PLANO ODONTOLÓGICO.


É claro que também temos um SEGURO DE VIDA que cobre as doenças ocupacionais.


Pensando em contribuir com sua refeição na hora do almoço, oferecemos o VALE REFEIÇÃO .


Para o seu salário render mais temos a ALLYA – plataforma de descontos.


E para se manter saudável, disponibilizamos o GYMPASS.


No mês do seu aniversário a Oncoclinicas&Co te presenteia com o DAY OFF , um dia de folga sem prejuízo na remuneração.


E para finalizar, nada mais justo do que dividir uma porcentagem do lucro com quem trabalhou por cada realização, não é mesmo? Então, se a Oncoclinicas&Co tem lucro você recebe uma grana a mais em nosso PROGRAMA DE LUCROS E RESULTADOS.


Venha construir com a gente!


Venha fazer parte do time de pessoas extraordinárias que atuam com a missão de vencer o câncer!

description:

Se você tem vontade de crescer e aprender sempre, e tem paixão em lidar com pessoas, esse pode ser o seu lugar!

Purpose

  • The Payroll and Benefits Team Lead is responsible for overseeing the payroll and benefits administration processes in a particular location to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant delivery of employee remuneration and associated benefits. This role requires a strong understanding of payroll regulations, benefits management, and employee satisfaction strategies while fostering alignment with global and local HR policies.

Responsibilities

  • You oversee the endtoend payroll process, ensuring accuracy and compliance with local labor laws, tax regulations, and SBM Offshore policies. You regularly monitor payroll outputs, promptly resolving any discrepancies or issues that arise. You ensure the timely submission of tax filings, social security contributions, and other statutory payments. Additionally, you collaborate with HR, Finance, and external vendors to maintain smooth and efficient payroll operations.
  • You manage various benefits programs, including health insurance, retirement plans, leave policies, and wellness initiatives. You review and suggest updates to benefits offerings to ensure they align with market trends and meet employee needs. You partner with benefits providers to maintain high service levels and cost efficiency, and you effectively communicate benefitsrelated information to employees.
  • You mentor and guide the Payroll and Benefits team, supporting their professional growth and development. You allocate responsibilities, monitor team performance, and address any skill gaps through training and support. You foster a collaborative work environment that aligns with SBM Offshore’s values and goals.
  • You ensure that payroll and benefits processes comply with local and global regulations, internal policies, and audits. You keep current on labor laws, tax regulations, and benefits trends to minimize risks. You support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation and reports as needed.
  • You continuously identify opportunities to streamline payroll and benefits processes using technology and best practices. You develop and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs), dashboards, and reports for HR and management review. Additionally, you contribute to HR strategic initiatives by providing valuable insights based on payroll and benefits data.

Global Industry Leader - Talent Data Solutions - Natural Resources and Energy

Do you want to impact our clients with your vision and experience? Do you believe in the power of doing more for clients?

This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from one of our offices in Latin America (Brazil, Chile and Colombia).

Please submit all application materials, including your résumé, in English.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

The Global Industry Leader for the Natural Resources and Energy sector is responsible for developing and delivering a strategic growth plan for the industry vertical. They build strong client relationships and lead business development initiatives. This role will be responsible for driving the successful implementation of the industry strategy across all client segments and regions, partnering with colleagues across business lines to harness broader Aon relationships to drive growth.

  • Develop and Implement Industry Growth Strategy: Define and implement a strategic plan to expand market share within the vertical, including identifying market opportunities and setting clear objectives.
  • Build and Maintain Client Relationships: Cultivate strong, trusted relationships with key client partners, understanding their business challenges and proactively identifying ways the firm can add new value.
  • Lead Business Development Efforts: Drive regional pipeline generation and conversion by identifying and prioritizing new opportunities and supporting regional sales teams on large enterprise deals.
  • Deliver Thought Leadership: Represent the firm as an industry expert by publishing insights, speaking publicly at conferences, and participating in industry forums to raise Aon's profile and credibility.
  • Lead Financial Performance: Oversee the vertical’s financial health, including revenue targets, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Develop and Grow Industry-Focused Teams: Mentor, and develop talent with relevant industry expertise, fostering a collaborative and impactful team culture.
  • Collaborate Across the Organization: Work closely with other vertical leaders, service line leads, and regional leaders to harness broader firm capabilities and client relationships.
  • Monitor Industry Trends and Regulatory Changes: Stay abreast of industry developments, regulatory shifts, and emerging risks to ensure the firm’s offerings remain relevant and compliant.
  • Drive Innovation and Solution Development: Identify client needs and market gaps, leading the development of new services, solutions, and delivery models tailored to the vertical.
  • Lead Collaborator Communication: Provide regular updates to executive leadership and other interested parties on vertical performance, critical initiatives, and key challenges.

How this opportunity is different

As a thought leader and industry expert, you will represent the firm in the market, track industry trends, and drive the creation of innovative, industry relevant and client-focused solutions. This is a pivotal leadership position for a committed professional with deep industry and reward expertise and a passion for delivering value to clients.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Ten plus years of experience in compensation.
  • Proven track record in the Natural Resources and Energy segment leading and driving growth in a complex global environment. Exceptional influential leadership.
  • Fluency in the English language.
  • Deep understanding of Human Capital universe and needs of clients across all segments, with strengths across Rewards and Analytics.
  • Hands‑on experience of shaping and executing against a client‑focused vision.
  • Proven track record of building go‑to‑market strategies and driving sustained results over both a short and long‑term horizon.
  • Ability to lead strategic thinking around innovation and ideation with a strong client and commercial lens.
  • Exceptional communication skills to convey compelling messages across all levels and geographies.
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment and lead through influence.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in relevant discipline or equivalent years of industry experience.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work… and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

title: Sr Business Development Manager, Flights LATAM
description:
About The Job

As a Business Development Manager, Airline Partnerships, you will support and grow relationships with a portfolio of airline distribution partners, helping to drive revenue growth and long-term collaboration. You will represent the company in day-to-day airline partner interactions, working closely with internal teams to execute commercial initiatives, support partner needs, and contribute to enterprise growth goals. This role requires a mix of account management, sales execution, and analytical skills. At Hopper, you can have an immediate impact in a high‑growth environment. Airline sales and distribution is a specialized field, so prior experience in airline distribution (OTA,MC, GDS, airline, etc.) is a strong plus, particularly within the LATAM market. Successful candidates will be able to clearly communicate Hopper’s value proposition and effectively our products and capabilities to airline partners.

What Your Day-to-day Would Look Like

  • Support the management of a portfolio of airline accounts, contributing to growth strategies and execution plans
  • Track partner performance, analyze results, and help identify risks and growth opportunities
  • Build a strong understanding of partner business objectives and assist in developing initiatives aligned with their strategy
  • Identify opportunities to improve commercial relationships and collaborate with internal teams to address them
  • Help organize and participate in quarterly business reviews with airline partners
  • Partner with finance teams to support forecasting and revenue tracking for airline partnerships
  • Assist in developing and executing marketing initiatives and insertion orders (I/Os) with airline partners in support of growth goals
  • Support contract negotiations, renewals, and amendments in collaboration with senior team members
  • Act as a liaison between airline partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operational execution and a strong traveler experience
  • Develop a working knowledge of the global travel market, with a focus on airline industry dynamics

An ideal candidate has

  • 3–5 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management with a track record of supporting revenue growth
  • Prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, or airline), with exposure to or experience in the LATAM market preferred
  • Familiarity with commercial, cultural, and regulatory dynamics of the LATAM travel ecosystem
  • A positive, proactive, and self‑motivated attitude
  • Ability to prepare and deliver clear, data-driven presentations
  • A collaborative, team-first mindset
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
  • A detail-oriented and analytical approach to problem‑solving
  • Passion for travel, technology, and digital commerce
  • Foundational value-selling skills and commercial acumen
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English & Portuguese

Perks And Benefits Of Working With Us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR-offered health, dental, life and short-term disability insurances with SulAmerica
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work-from-home stipend
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business
  • Open communication with management and company leadership
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

More About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels.

As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Júnior | IAM
description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros. Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

A área de IAM é responsável por garantir que cada pessoa e sistema tenha o acesso certo, no momento certo e apenas ao que precisa, usando ferramentas como Entra ID, Active Directory e SailPoint. Ela cuida de todo o ciclo de vida do usuário, desde a criação da conta, mudanças de função, até o desligamento, além de controlar acessos, autenticações e integrações com sistemas internos e SaaS.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Operar e dar suporte ao ambiente de Identidade e Acesso;
  • Garantir que usuários, sistemas e aplicações tenham os acessos corretos e seguros;
  • Tratar chamados de IAM dentro do SLA de atendimento;
  • Acompanhar e corrigir falhas de provisionamento e desprovisionamento;
  • Apoiar criação, alteração e remoção de acessos no MS Entra ID, Active Directory, SailPoint e aplicações integradas;
  • Executar e acompanhar os fluxos de Joiner, Mover e Leaver;
  • Apoiar revisões de acesso e campanhas de certificação;
  • Testar e validar integrações via SCIM e APIs usando Postman;
  • Rodar e ajustar automações simples em PowerShell;
  • Documentar/atualizar processos;
  • Apoiar na governança.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD);
  • Experiência com Active Directory (on-premises e híbrido);
  • Experiência com SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC);
  • Conhecimento em Identity Lifecycle Management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver);
  • Conhecimento em processos de provisionamento e desprovisionamento de contas e acessos;
  • Conhecimento em RBAC (controle de acesso baseado em papéis);
  • Noções de auditoria de acessos, revisões e compliance (SoD, Least Privilege);
  • Experiência com Postman para testes e validação de integrações.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em SCIM;
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, JSON e Web Services;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de autenticação e autorização (OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0 e OpenID Connect);
  • Experiência com ferramentas ITSM, como Freshservice;
  • Conhecimento em PowerShell e/ou Python;
  • Experiência com Logic Apps e Azure Functions;
  • Conhecimento em Azure Key Vault (AKV) para gestão de segredos, credenciais e tokens;
  • Conhecimento em workflows, rules e transforms no SailPoint ISC;
  • Experiência com integração de aplicações corporativas e SaaS;
  • Noções de segurança em APIs;
  • Certificações em IAM, Cloud ou Segurança da Informação.

Local

Rio de Janeiro-RJ ou São Paulo-SP

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos: Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

description:
O que nos move

A paixão por esportes é indiscutível. Mas o que realmente nos move é transformar a forma como o esporte é consumido , combinando criatividade, tecnologia, dados e execução em alta velocidade. Na LiveMode , desenvolvemos soluções digitais que conectam clubes, federações, ligas, atletas e marcas ao público de forma relevante, autêntica e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital, das redes sociais e da TV .

Com essa visão de futuro, estamos formando um Banco de Talentos para profissionais que desejam atuar como Produtor(a) de Conteúdos – Redes Sociais , jogando junto ao nosso time de Conteúdo , com oportunidades no Rio de Janeiro (100% Presencial) . Mesmo que não tenhamos uma vaga aberta neste momento, seu perfil poderá ser considerado para oportunidades futuras, de acordo com sua experiência, senioridade e os projetos da LiveMode.

Aqui, cada movimento é uma jogada estratégica, e queremos pessoas que entendam o tamanho do jogo.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, produzir e publicar conteúdos para redes sociais, garantindo consistência editorial, agilidade e alinhamento com a estratégia de cada projeto.
  • Atuar em coberturas de eventos esportivos, jogos e ativações especiais, incluindo finais de semana e horários alternativos, conforme o calendário esportivo.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times de Design, Audiovisual, Produto e Comercial, transformando ideias, pautas e dados em conteúdo relevante para diferentes plataformas.
  • Analisar performance e comportamento de audiência, propondo ajustes e novos formatos com base em dados, tendências e contexto esportivo.
  • Contribuir para inovação de linguagem e formatos, acompanhando o que há de mais atual em redes sociais, cultura digital e consumo de conteúdo esportivo.

Requisitos necessários

  • Experiência prévia com produção de conteúdo para redes sociais, seja em veículos de mídia, projetos digitais, marcas ou criadores.
  • Familiaridade com o universo esportivo, entender o jogo importa. Modalidade específica pode variar, mas repertório é essencial.
  • Vivência com rotinas de publicação, cobertura em tempo real e adaptação rápida a mudanças de contexto.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de alta demanda e múltiplos projetos.
  • Perfil mão na massa, com senso de responsabilidade e execução consistente.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência em grupos de mídia, projetos esportivos, plataformas digitais ou streaming.
  • Conhecimento em vídeo para redes sociais, edição básica ou direção de conteúdo audiovisual.
  • Vivência com planejamento de cobertura esportiva, cronogramas editoriais e storytelling multiplataforma.
  • Interesse ou uso prático de IA e novas tecnologias aplicadas à produção de conteúdo.
  • Ideias, projetos autorais ou experimentações que demonstrem inquietação criativa e vontade de fazer diferente.

Nossos benefícios

  • Auxílio Alimentação de R$ 1.250,00 por mês, para utilização em restaurantes, mercados, aplicativos de comida e outros estabelecimentos físicos ou online.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional) caso opte pelo benefício, haverá desconto de 6% do salário bruto, conforme previsto na CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde (Especial – SulAmérica) sem custo mensal para o colaborador, com coparticipação de 10% em consultas e exames. É permitida a inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com custos por conta do colaborador e mesma coparticipação.
  • Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC) sem custo mensal para o colaborador para o plano "Mais Doc", com possibilidade de migração para outros planos (diferença de valor descontada em folha) e inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com desconto em folha.
  • TotalPass e Wellhub (opcionais) o colaborador pode escolher a plataforma que melhor atender às suas necessidades. Ambas oferecem acesso a academias de diversas modalidades, esportes variados e aplicativos de saúde física, mental e financeira.
  • Auxílio-Creche para filhos de até 5 anos e 11 meses, com reembolso de despesas em creches, escolas ou com profissional regularizado (babá ou autônomo).
  • Auxílio para Dependentes PCD para colaboradores que apoiam pessoas com deficiência, mediante apresentação de laudo médico.
  • Seguro de Vida (Prudential) é uma proteção financeira para o colaborador e seus beneficiários em momentos de adversidade.
  • SESC oferece acesso a atividades culturais, esportivas, de lazer, saúde e educação, incentivando um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado.
  • Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e familiares.

Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte, e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontem, hoje e sempre. Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos. Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande. A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO . Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

title: AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship (Fully Funded)
description:
AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship (Fully Funded)

The AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship is a prestigious international fellowship organised by the (IAS) . The fellowship supports digital creators, advocates, and professionals working to advance HIV prevention knowledge, access, and community engagement , with full participation at AIDS 2026 in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

The programme combines funding, global exposure, professional development, and international travel for selected fellows.

Scholarship Details

  • Host: International AIDS Society (IAS)
  • Event: AIDS 2026 – 26th International AIDS Conference
  • Conference Dates: 25 – 30 July 2026
  • Fellowship Period: March 2026 – 14 August 2026
  • Application Deadline: 15 February 2026 (23:00 CET)
  • Financial support of up to USD 500 for a digital HIV prevention content project before AIDS 2026
  • Financial support of up to USD 500 for a digital content project during AIDS 2026
  • Full support to attend AIDS 2026 in person , including:
    • International travel
    • Accommodation
    • Per diem
    • Ground transportation (where applicable)
  • Opportunity to:
    • Amplify HIV prevention messaging globally
    • Translate scientific and policy discussions into accessible digital content
    • Network with researchers, policymakers, activists, and global health leaders
  • Participation in professional development, networking, and advocacy activities

Applicants must meet all of the following:

  • Be 18 years or older at the time of application
  • Have a proven track record in advancing HIV prevention knowledge or access (e.g. PrEP, PEP, U=U, harm reduction, policy, long-acting prevention)
  • Demonstrate content creation experience on HIV prevention through:
    • Social or digital platforms (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, X, Bluesky)
    • Podcasts, blogs, newsletters, or community radio
  • Have a minimum reach of 5,000 total followers/subscribers across platforms , OR documented community reach and engagement
  • Commit to ethical, evidence-based, non-stigmatizing, rights-based communication
  • Virtual pre-event onboarding

Priority Will Be Given To Applicants Who:

  • Represent or work closely with key and priority populations, including:
    • People living with HIV
    • Men who have sex with men
    • Trans people
    • Sex workers
    • People who inject drugs
    • Adolescent girls and young women
    • Migrants and underserved communities
  • Are based in low- and middle-income countries
  • Produce content for underserved audiences
  • Have experience collaborating with community-led organisations, clinics, or advocacy coalitions
  • Descriptions of two digital HIV prevention communication projects :
    • One to be implemented before AIDS 2026
    • One to be implemented during AIDS 2026
  • For each project:
    • Intended outcomes
    • Planned themes
    • Target audiences
    • Platforms to be used
    • Two sample posts showing how the project would look
  • Portfolio and/or links to recent prevention-related digital content (last 6–12 months)
  • Evidence of reach (screenshots of analytics or engagement metrics)
  • Letter of support (if employed)
  • Letter of reference (if self-employed)

Deadline

  • Application Closes: 15 February 2026 at 23:00 CET

Late or incomplete applications will not be considered.

  • Download and complete the official AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship application form
  • Prepare all required documents and project descriptions
  • Submit your application before the deadline

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. All application information will be treated confidentially.

FAQs

Is this a fully funded opportunity? Yes. Selected fellows receive funding for digital projects and full support to attend AIDS 2026 in Brazil.

Do I need to be a medical professional? No. Applicants may be content creators, advocates, researchers, community workers, or digital communicators with proven HIV prevention engagement.

Can social media creators apply? Yes. Creators on platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, blogs, podcasts, and community media are encouraged to apply.

Is English mandatory? Yes. English proficiency is required to engage with AIDS 2026 content and communications.

Can applicants from Africa apply? Yes. Applicants from low- and middle-income countries, including African countries, are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Senior Investment Analyst
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us! We are searching for a Senior Investment Analyst who will be responsible for research and analytical duties surrounding the Endowment and Retirement Trust. Outputs of analysis will include preparation of reporting materials such as asset allocation, evaluating performance of existing managers, preparation of cash balances and interaction with custodian. Howard University Investment Office is responsible for the management of the Endowment/Investment Pool and the Retirement Trust totaling an aggregated AUM over $1.6 billion in accordance with Board of Trustee approved investment policy and asset allocation. The University has benefited from tremendous leadership by the President and Senior Administration in attracting world-class students and faculty and positioning the University in the short and long-term. The growth in Endowment supports these efforts and the Retirement Trust funding ratio is the highest in its recent history. Senior Investment Analyst will be supportive of the Chief Investment and Deputy Chief Investment Officer, primarily accountable for ongoing performance analysis, documentation, and reporting activities of the Investment Office related to the selection, monitoring and oversight of the Endowment\'s external investment managers. This role is heavily involved in the office\'s data collection and retention process. In addition to working closely with members of the investment team, this role will interact with other University departments and external entities including the Endowment\'s investment managers and administrators, custodian bank, and auditors. The Senior Investment Operations Analyst will be responsible for producing high quality work, including material that is readily presentable to constituencies inside and outside of the Investment Office.

Nature And Scope

The investment portfolio invests in diversified asset classes including domestic and international equities, domestic and global bonds, Inflation Hedging and Alternative strategies such as hedge funds, private equity and real assets. The Endowment and Retirement Funds uses external investment managers through commingled vehicles, separate accounts, trusts and limited partnerships. Manager selection, diligence and asset class assumptions accomplished with assistance of consultants and other partners.

Operational

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Oversee with the CIO and DCIO, the investment portfolio and related projects including cash reconciliation, return and risk calculations, documentation requests, workflow details with Treasury.
  • Take ownership of pacing analysis and capital call adherence

Investment Operations For Risk Management And Performance Attribution

  • Responsible for the selection, development and maintenance of the analytics system for research management and investment performance attribution and risk management. Work with the Information Services Department as a partner, when appropriate
  • Work to ensure that all documents and contracts secure the rights and property of the University.

Administration

  • Help create materials for Investment Committee meetings
  • Participate, in a general sense, as a team member of the Howard University Investment Office.

Investment Research, Manager Due Diligence And Fund Selection

  • Evaluate current and recommend new investment managers
  • Perform statistical analysis and general research related to the capital markets for purposes of defining options for continuous investment improvements and recommendations for tactical strategies within asset classes to enhance performance of the overall portfolio
  • Analyze investment performance and investment related issues and prepare material for the CIO and presentations (verbal and written) to the Investment Committee.
  • Review all footnotes of all presentation materials of external manager investments
  • Review appropriateness of investment fees and costs and recommend reductions

Projects

  • Perform periodic studies, such as benchmarking on different investment issues, and manage projects as assigned.

Other Duties

  • As assigned

Core Competencies

  • Advanced excel modeling
  • Investment Banking or institutional finance training
  • Significant written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to deliver accurate deliverables
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently, identify problems, priorities, solutions
  • Knowledge of investment portfolio theory and process of manager evaluation and selection

Professional Development

  • Enhance professional growth by participating in educational programs and professional organizations and activities to maintain knowledge of national and international trends and to promote edge performance and expertise.
  • Attend conferences and seminars to enhance understanding of current operational issues, which impact portfolio and investment results. Network with other endowments and foundations to learn of investment programs, strategies and systems which may be applicable to Howard University.

Minimum Requirements

Requires a minimum of 10 years of endowment, foundation or investment experience; skills in both written and oral communication; knowledge of investment concepts in a broad range of asset classes. The ideal candidate would possess deep knowledge of equity and fixed income strategies, CFA designation, MBA in Finance, and experience in private markets would be preferred.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range: $150,000 - $175,000

Are you passionate about social media and excited about adapting global content to local audiences? Do you enjoy short-form video, feel comfortable on camera, and love turning ideas into engaging posts, stories, and videos?

At Metricool, we’re looking for a Social Media Manager & Content Creator to own and manage our social media presence in Brazil, one of our most strategic growth markets.

You’ll work 100% remotely in an international, fast-growing company, with a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and analytical thinking.

Your mission is to make Metricool relevant and recognizable in Brazil through social media. You’ll do this by adapting and publishing global content for the local market, managing our day-to-day social media presence, and creating video-first content that reflects Brazilian culture and trends.

Content Creator

  • Adapt global social media campaigns, launches, and evergreen content to the Brazilian market, ensuring cultural relevance and a local tone.
  • Research and propose native content ideas based on Brazilian social media trends, memes, creator formats, and platform-specific behaviors.
  • Write and adapt captions in Brazilian Portuguese, aligned with Metricool’s brand voice and messaging guidelines.
  • Act as a brand representative on camera, recording educational, promotional, and trend-based content.
  • Record short-form video content (TikTok & Instagram Reels) on a weekly basis.
  • Create occasional long-form video content (tutorials, feature explanations, or campaign support).

Social Media Manager

  • Manage and grow Metricool’s Brazilian social media channels, mainly Instagram and LinkedIn.
  • Schedule and publish content according to the local content calendar.
  • Monitor performance and identify which formats, topics, and narratives resonate most with the Brazilian audience.
  • Engage with the community by responding to comments and relevant interactions when needed.
  • Share insights, trends, and performance learnings with the global marketing team to inform experimentation and strategy.

First days at Metricool

  • First month: For the first few weeks, we will ensure you understand your impact on the team and the business and learn about the team, the industry, and processes. You will meet every contributor on your team and understand their areas of expertise.
  • First Quarter: Within the first three months, you will understand your team better, work autonomously, and begin sharing new ideas and creating a more significant impact.
  • To the moon: After this process, you will become an active team member. You will also understand how to reach objectives and set your strategies based on the company's goals.

Job requirements

  • Must be located in Brazil.
  • Experience: 3-5 years of previous experience in a Social Media Management & Content Creation role.
  • Education: Degree in Digital Marketing or a similar field.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese, advanced English. Advanced level in Spanish is a plus.

Hard skills

  • Strong experience managing social media accounts professionally.
  • Proven experience creating short-form, mobile-first video content.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian social media culture, trends and creators ecosystems.

Soft skills

  • Strong storytelling and on-camera presence.
  • Creative mindset with a strong sense of cultural relevance.
  • Ability to translate global brand messaging into local content.
  • Proactivity, autonomy, and ownership.
  • Flexibility and willingness to experiment and iterate.

Why you will fall in love with Metricool

  • Remote Work Environment: Team members have the flexibility to work from any location of their choice. All processes are designed to accommodate remote work, fostering inclusivity and communication through platforms like Slack or Meets.
  • Annual Meetups: Once a year, we organize an event to bring the team together, fostering camaraderie and mutual understanding.
  • Competitive Salary: We are actively working to align our budgets with market standards, offering highly competitive salary packages. The salary band for this position is between 4500 BRL and 9000 BRL gross per month.
  • Professional Development Plan: Recognizing the desire for personal growth, we provide guidance and support to our team members on their professional journey.
  • English Language Lessons: As an international company, we provide support in English language, as well as other languages in cases when it’s relevant for the role and the team.

Hiring process steps

  • First interview (30 minutes) with Sofía, People & Culture Specialist, to know each other, know more about the company and our culture, the position and the team, and if your background and aspirations fit the profile.
  • Second interview (30 minutes) with Ana, our Content Manager, and Ori, our Social Media Team Lead, to get a better understanding of the role’s mission and expectation and to verify the fit with the company.

Coordenador(a) de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O Coordenador(a) de Projeto terá a responsabilidade de implementar o projeto Apoio a Distância na comunidade Morro dos Cabritos e implementar as atividades referentes a esse programa. Além disso deverá participar dos eventos comunitários que serão realizados em parceria com uma empresa patrocinadora e executar ações pontuais de promoção social.

Apoiar a realização pontual de eventos comunitários que AVSI está realizando em parceria com uma empresa patrocinadora.

Organizar o trabalho do projeto Apoio a Distância (SAD) que irá começar no Morro dos Cabritos, em Copacabana.

Elaborar diagnóstico social de famílias e comunidades em situação de vulnerabilidade e promover a elaboração, implementação e monitoramento de planos de acompanhamento familiar.

Promover o acesso a direitos sociais e políticas públicas (assistência, saúde, educação, habitação);

Articular as familias com a rede socioassistencial e intersetorial (CRAS, CREAS, escolas, unidades de saúde, Judiciário);

Elaborar relatórios sociais, pareceres técnicos e estudos de caso;

Planejar e execução de ações socioeducativas e preventivas

Acompanhar e monitorar indicadores sociais ligados a realização dos plano de acompanhamento familiar

Requisitos

Escolaridade

  • Graduação

Habilidade Técnica

  • Sólido conhecimento do pacote Office, em especial Excel - Avançado
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Serviço Social, com Conselhor Regional de Serviço Social (CRESS) ativo - Avançado
  • Possuir experiência prévia em projetos sociais e com atividades de promoção social; - Avançado
  • Possuir experiência comprovada com atuação direta no acompanhamento social de famílias em situação de vulnerabilidade social, com foco no fortalecimento de vínculos familiares e comunitários; - Avançado
  • Possuir experiência com elaboração e execução de planos de acompanhamento familiar; - Avançado
  • Possuir disponibilidade para atuar nos finais de semana e feriados. - Avançado
  • Possuir experiência em produção de conteúdo social e análise de indicadores; - Avançado
  • Desejável possuir CNH B e prática na direção; - Básico

title: Influencer Talent Manager
description:
Remote - Work from anywhere

⏰ Flexible hours - Choose your own schedule

About us

Grail Talent is an Influencer Management Agency that connects our diverse and carefully curated roster of content creators with digital marketing opportunities, working with brands and record labels to advertise products and music on social media through influencer promotion and performance marketing.

We work with some of the biggest players in Music and New Media, including Sony Music Entertainment and Amazon Prime Video, to help promote the next viral sensation or hit show.

In doing so, we are shaping the future of how digital marketing budgets are spent; delivering dynamic and creative promotional campaigns across a variety of social media channels such as TikTok and Instagram, and measuring their impact with detailed analytics.

Job Summary

As an Influencer Talent Manager, you will be responsible for managing the careers of our creators, helping them grow their audience and monetise their content. Using our in-house software and your own expertise, you will also be responsible for negotiating deals with brands/record labels and developing content strategies for our clients.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage & Scale Creators: Oversee influencer portfolios and help talent grow their platform presence while securing brand deals.
  • Talent Acquisition: Scout and sign new creators, focusing on emerging and established influencers.
  • Foster Brand Relationships: Build and nurture strong partnerships with brands and agencies to book top talent for campaigns.
  • Strategic Growth: Collaborate with internal teams to shape the overall strategy and expand Grail’s talent roster.
  • Autonomous & Flexible Work: Thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while having the flexibility to work independently and remotely.

Qualifications

  • Already very familiar with TikTok and what it’s all about.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Ready to hustle to get the job done.
  • The hunger to make quick opportunistic wins, and the patience to work long cycles.
  • Prepared to work flexible hours.
  • Ability to work autonomously and drive your own agenda.
  • Passion for, or ambition to change how things are done.
  • Experience with talent management, social media influencers, sales, marketing agencies (bonus).

Why Join Grail Talent?

  • Unlimited Earning Potential: Your income directly reflects your performance, with uncapped commission earnings.
  • Work with Global Brands: Collaborate with top brands like Amazon, Gucci, and Sony Music to execute major influencer marketing campaigns.
  • Career Growth: Join a growing company with the opportunity to lead and shape the influencer management team.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy flexibility with remote work options and the ability to manage your own schedule.
  • Creative & Collaborative Culture: Work with a dynamic, passionate team that values innovation and creativity.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you’re excited about shaping the careers of Instagram influencers and want to help lead the future of influencer marketing, we’d love to hear from you! Please submit your resume along with a cover letter detailing your experience and qualifications.

title: Product Manager de Inteligência Artificial (AI Product Manager)
description:
A pessoa Product Manager de Inteligência Artificial irá definir e gerenciar a estratégia de produtos de Inteligência Artificial da empresa, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.

Será responsável por identificar oportunidades de aplicação de IA, priorizar casos de uso, construir e gerenciar o roadmap de produtos de IA, traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos, e garantir a entrega de valor mensurável através de soluções de IA. Irá liderar a descoberta, validação e evolução de produtos de IA, assegurando alinhamento estratégico, viabilidade técnica, adoção pelos usuários e retorno sobre investimento.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Definir e manter a estratégia de produtos de IA da empresa, construindo e gerenciando roadmap priorizado de iniciativas, alinhado aos objetivos estratégicos do negócio e às capacidades tecnológicas, garantindo visibilidade e comunicação clara para stakeholders;
  • Conduzir pesquisas contínuas com usuários e áreas de negócio para identificar oportunidades de aplicação de IA, problemas a serem resolvidos e necessidades não atendidas, validando hipóteses através de discovery techniques e análise de viabilidade;
  • Avaliar e priorizar casos de uso de IA baseado em critérios de valor de negócio, esforço técnico, viabilidade, impacto estratégico e riscos, gerenciando portfólio de iniciativas e garantindo alocação eficiente de recursos;
  • Planejar e conduzir experimentos, MVPs e POCs para validar hipóteses de produto antes de investimentos maiores, utilizando abordagens lean e iterativas, coletando feedback e aprendizados para informar decisões de produto;
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de sucesso e KPIs para produtos de IA, medir valor entregue (eficiência, produtividade, receita, satisfação), ROI de iniciativas, e utilizar dados para otimização e tomada de decisão;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com equipes de engenharia, IA e design durante o ciclo de desenvolvimento, participando de cerimônias ágeis, removendo impedimentos, validando entregas e garantindo qualidade e aderência aos requisitos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Produção, Administração com foco em Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável ter Pós-Graduação, MBA ou especialização em Gestão de Produtos, Product Management, Inteligência Artificial, Transformação Digital, Inovação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em gestão de produtos digitais ou de tecnologia;
  • Experiência prática trabalhando com produtos de IA, Machine Learning ou tecnologias emergentes;
  • Experiência comprovada em descoberta e validação de produtos, construção e gestão de roadmaps de produtos, mensuração de valor e métricas de produto;
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis e práticas de product discovery;

description:
About BCG Platinion

BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading-edge tech platforms, at scale.

Practice Area

BCG Platinion launched in Germany in 2000 to add deep technical expertise to the Boston Consulting Group’s existing capabilities. Today, our presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. Our New York-based North American team began in 2014 and in 2017 acquired MAYA Design, a Pittsburgh-based digital design and innovation lab, to grow our capabilities around technology and design.

What You'll Do

Responsibilities

  • Management of work packages/modules in critical IT implementation projects
  • Technical architecture, code reviews & performance of technical proofs of concept
  • Analysis of complex IT application landscapes, optimization of development processes and Solution Architecture
  • Functional and technical online and Internet strategies
  • IT project management and quality assurance

Our Expert Consulting Track

The Expert Consulting Track (ECT) is vital to BCG’s ability to successfully meet our clients’ demand for deep expertise and advanced technical capabilities. Experts deliver next-level impact for BCG's most complex and cutting-edge client challenges. Experts focus on developing BCG’s thought leadership, commercial capabilities, and intellectual property assets; and their work is essential to our delivery model. Working as part of a multidisciplinary team to bring the ‘best of BCG’ to our clients, Experts come from diverse backgrounds, with expertise often gained outside of BCG in industry, academia, or specialized consulting.

What You'll Bring

  • Between 6 -10 years' experience in software development, technical project management, digital delivery or technology consulting
  • Full understanding of interdependencies between your own work stream and the overall project context, being able to scope and design a work stream autonomously and take responsibility for it
  • Can run a workshop at peer level: effectively facilitating client meetings, preparing CTMs, co‑leading a content topic as well as coaching other project members and able to generate trust, to be perceived by the client as a potential partner
  • A university degree with above‑average academic performance in a STEM related field
  • Extensive technical expertise (overarching understanding of architecture, object‑oriented programming languages, database design and systems, component technologies, XML standards, and current technology trends) of digital solutions on mobile devices as well as legacy environments
  • Extensive experience in the assessment of IT target architectures in an enterprise environment, component technologies, and service‑oriented architectures
  • Experience with No‑SQL and SQL DBs, also exposure to big data environments (e.g., Hadoop, Redshift)
  • Technical experience with Cloud services and Infraestructure

Who You'll Work With

  • BCG Managing Directors and Partners (MDP’s)
  • PLA Managing Directors (MD’s)
  • BCG Consultants at all level
  • PLA Consultants at all level
  • Clients, vendors, and partners

description:
Canonical is hiring a Python Software Engineer to join the Certification team, who make the tools which enable us to know that a desktop, laptop, server or IoT device is working properly. We work at the interface of hardware and software, so the ideal candidate is a Python developer familiar with hardware.

The Certification team develops the tools needed to certify hardware as working with Ubuntu Core as well as Ubuntu Desktop and Server: We design hardware which can be used to probe devices independently, and frameworks for software tests that check every aspect of Ubuntu on that hardware.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact for adoption of Linux across multiple device categories and industries. Canonical offers a fun, fast‑paced team environment and a career full of learning and development opportunities. This team is centered in EMEA time zones, and works with colleagues on related teams in both the Americas and APAC.

We work together with silicon companies, OEMs, ODMs and teams within Canonical to ensure a smooth, secure out of the box Ubuntu experience, with success in this role leading to a great Ubuntu experience being offered on more and more devices.

Role description

We are looking for a self‑motivated software engineer with experience developing in Python, to work on test automation tools or Linux based embedded hardware. This role offers an exciting opportunity to push the industry forward by enabling entirely new Linux based hardware testing capabilities, scaling up hardware certification efforts and allowing for deeper test coverage. The role involves the development and maintenance of Canonical's open source certification tools, supporting the creation of hardware solutions for test automation, and automating our existing processes. We seek out continuous process and tooling improvements as part of expanding the certification test suites, ultimately to improve the quality of Linux experience felt by millions of Linux end users.

Key responsibilities

  • Maintain and develop new features to our Python based test automation tools like Checkbox, used by both in‑house teams and industry partners.
  • Invent new ways to enable remote, automated testing.
  • Help build the software counterpart to in‑house designed testing hardware to help test device enablement (graphics, hotplug, bluetooth, etc).
  • Write functional and performance tests to support hardware enablement and to protect from regressions.
  • Participate in meetings involving international travel 2‑3 times per year.

Required Skills And Experience

  • Knowledge of Python programming language.
  • Quality oriented, pragmatic approach to software design and implementation.
  • Interest in test automation methodologies.
  • Previous experience working with Ubuntu or other Linux distributions.
  • Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team.

Desired Skills And Experience

  • Passion for tinkering: you are a maker.
  • Experience working in an agile environment.
  • Hardware testing experience, for example in the IoT space.
  • Familiarity with the C programming language.

What is Canonical?

Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open‑source community to deliver Ubuntu, "the world's best free software platform". Our services help businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu.

  • Facilita e assegura a conformidade com as regulamentações e normas brasileiras de HSE em todas as operações;
  • Mantém registros e documentação relacionados a HSE e garante que o Contratado cumpra os requisitos acordados de retenção de registros conforme contrato;

  • Participa/lidera reuniões pré-tarefa, palestras de segurança, reuniões de progresso, debriefings e garante que os trabalhadores estejam presentes, informados e conscientes da tarefa;
  • Desenvolve, implementa e ministra treinamentos de integração de HSE em nome da Companhia;
  • Apoia campanhas de HSE, iniciativas de conscientização, programas de comportamento e reconhecimento em nome da Companhia;
  • Facilita e orienta programas de coaching e mentoring de HSE para todo o pessoal no site;

  • Identifica lacunas de fatores humanos que impedem operações sem incidentes; propõe planos preventivos e corretivos;

  • Fornece relatório completo de passagem de turno ao final de cada rotação;
  • Implementa iniciativas dos programas de Segurança da companhia como “Safety Green Light”, “Life Saving Checks”,, auditorias de permissão de trabalho, Diálogo de Segurança etc.;
  • Participa e promove a cultura de segurança a bordo do FPSO (compartilhamento de comunicados de segurança).

Gestão de Riscos

  • Identifica e aborda riscos de HSE e fornece orientação sobre medidas preventivas e corretivas; elabora planos de ação conforme solicitado;
  • Garante que todas as operações e atividades sejam submetidas à análise de risco;
  • Participa, realiza e/ou revisa Análises de Segurança de Trabalho (AST) e avaliações de risco com as entidades envolvidas;
  • Utiliza ferramentas disponíveis (LSC – “Life Saving Checks”) para garantir que as operações sejam gerenciadas adequadamente.
  • Apoia a implementação de planos e programas ambientais no site em nome da Companhia;
  • Garante que o Contratado possua, acompanhe, revise e atualize planos de gestão ambiental, gestão de resíduos, gestão de produtos químicos, entre outros;
  • Interage com pessoal de HSE do Contratado para realizar monitoramento de conformidade ambiental no site; inicia ações corretivas em caso de não conformidades;
  • Apoia, no nível do site, os seguintes projetos regulatórios ambientais e garante que os Requisitos sejam cumpridos:
  • o Projeto de Controle da Poluição (PCP);
  • Apoia pessoal treinado na implementação das ações exigidas pelo PMAVE (monitoramento dos impactos de plataformas e embarcações sobre a avifauna);
  • Administra sistemas de rastreamento de registros ambientais no site.

Preservação da Saúde e Higiene Industrial

  • Verifica se o Contratado cumpre todos os requisitos regulatórios para preservação da saúde no site (PPRA etc.);
  • Apoia a implementação de planos e programas de higiene industrial no site;
  • Verifica a seleção e aquisição adequadas de EPIs e equipamentos de segurança da Companhia no site.

Treinamento e Competência

  • Educa, motiva e treina pessoal da Companhia e do Contratado em questões de HSE;
  • Controla a conformidade da matriz de treinamentos de HSE do Contratado;
  • Aplica o PEAT (Projeto de Educação Ambiental dos Trabalhadores) para todo o pessoal a bordo do FPSO.

Gestão de Emergências

  • Apoia a aplicação do sistema de resposta a emergências conforme requisitos do documento de interface;
  • Participa de exercícios organizados no site pela Companhia e/ou Contratado;
  • Acompanha plano de ações de melhoria após os exercícios;
  • Controla disponibilidade e adequação de equipamentos de resposta a emergências (combate a incêndio, SOPEP etc.) e primeiros socorros.

Auditorias, Inspeções e Revisões

  • Realiza inspeções diárias nas áreas de trabalho, condições e permissões de trabalho;
  • Realiza inspeções nos alojamentos em intervalos regulares;
  • Participa de auditorias programadas e não programadas com a gestão da Companhia, Contratado e outras partes aplicáveis;
  • Lidera e apoia CSR/RSES em auditorias do Sistema de Gestão de HSE/ISO 14001/ISO 50001.

Gestão de Eventos, Melhoria de Performance e Gestão de Dados

  • Reporta desempenho de HSE do Contratado: documenta, acompanha anomalias, quase-acidentes, incidentes e qualquer outro evento de HSE no site conforme requisitos da Companhia;
  • Propõe ações para melhoria contínua de HSE no site;
  • Participa de investigações de quase-acidentes no site;
  • Atua como condutor de análises de causa raiz para Acidentes de alo potencial a bordo do FPSO – monitora os planos de ação;
  • Auxilia o CSR/RSES na condução e gestão dos sistemas de Controle de Risco de Segurança e Meio Ambiente; investiga causas raiz de incidentes e acidentes e define ações corretivas relevantes.

Gestão Social

  • No âmbito do Projeto de Comunicação Social (PCS), monitora, contata por rádio e registra 100% das embarcações não autorizadas que entram na zona de exclusão de 500 m do FPSO.

Perfil do Candidato

A posição requer um diploma de engenharia de uma universidade reconhecida no Brasil, bem como experiência na indústria de óleo e gás, em uma função de HSE.

Qualificações necessárias:

  • Disposição para aplicar padrões e procedimentos de HSE de forma respeitosa e obter comprometimento do pessoal do Contratado;
  • Capacidade de comunicação e interação com gestão, supervisores e pessoal do site para coordenar trabalho seguro;
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas e questões de forma independente e lidar com múltiplas tarefas simultaneamente;
  • Excelente conhecimento das regulamentações brasileiras de HSE (NR, CONAMA etc.);
  • Excelente compreensão dos requisitos, restrições e obrigações estabelecidos pela Licença de Operação;
  • Habilidade com programas e sistemas MS e aplicações (Synergi, Enablon, HRAF etc.).
