description:
Transformar vidas com saúde é o que nos move!

Atuamos em todo o Brasil por meio de duas unidades de negócios, Amil e Rede Total Care, com mais de 1.500 hospitais credenciados e uma rede própria de hospitais, clínicas, centros de tratamento, home care e transporte médico.

Com uma missão clara e valores sólidos, fortalecemos nossa cultura com compromisso de servir sempre melhor. Cuidamos das nossas pessoas colaboradoras para que esse cuidado se reflita na população que atendemos.

Promovemos uma cultura inovadora, diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. Todas as candidaturas qualificadas são bem-vindas, sem distinção de etnia, raça, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, idade, nacionalidade, religião ou qualquer outro marcador social.

Reforçamos Que Não Solicitamos Pagamentos, Taxas Ou Códigos SMS Em Nossos Processos Seletivos. Todas As Oportunidades Estão Disponíveis Em Nossos Canais Oficiais e No Nosso Site De Carreira. Qualquer Situação Diferente Deve Ser Denunciada.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar o recebimento de medicamentos e materiais entregues nas unidades, efetuando o recebimento conforme procedimento operacional padrão estabelecido pela companhia, utilizando instrumento adequado para tal processo;
  • Executar o processo de entrada de notas fiscais no SAP conforme procedimento interno padronizado, com eficiência e dentro dos tempos e movimentos preconizados; Exercer processo de armazenamento dos materiais e medicamentos recebidos conforme boas práticas de armazenamento e procedimentos internos, mantendo os insumos em condições adequadas de uso.
  • Realizar diariamente o processo de dispensação de medicamentos e materiais em atendimento a prescrições médicas ou demais requisições, efetuando todas as etapas descritas em procedimento operacional padrão da atividade, garantindo assim que os medicamentos e materiais solicitados sejam dispensados corretamente, evitando erros de dispensação. Executar o processo de devolução de materiais e medicamentos recolhidos nos postos assistenciais e centro cirúrgico conforme procedimento operacional previamente estabelecido.
  • Realizar diariamente a reposição dos endereçamentos com medicamentos e materiais, realizando todas as etapas descritas em procedimento operacional padrão da atividade, visando garantir a disponibilidade e localização dos medicamentos e materiais, além de realizar todos os atendimentos necessários para reabastecimento das farmácias satélites e setores assistenciais; Realizar diariamente o processo de unitarização de medicamentos e materiais efetuando todas as etapas descritas em procedimento operacional padrão da atividade, visando assegurar que os procedimentos e legislações estejam sendo cumpridas.
  • Verificar mensalmente o prazo de validade dos medicamentos e materiais e anotá‑lo em formulário específico para que os farmacêuticos acompanhem os produtos com prazo de validade expirada ou próximo ao vencimento.
  • Realizar diariamente processo de contagem de medicamentos controlados, conforme recorrência e processos corporativamente estabelecidos;
  • Realizar diariamente a contagem dos medicamentos e materiais da curva ABC, anotando na planilha de contagem o saldo no físico e no sistema informatizado, visando garantir o controle de estoque destes insumos contribuindo para acurácia de estoque;
  • Participar da equipe de inventários sempre que solicitado;
  • Realizar diariamente o processo de montagem de kits de centro cirúrgico, hemodinâmica em atendimento a agenda de cirurgias do dia, seguindo os procedimentos padronizados por diretrizes corporativas;
  • Executar todos os procedimentos pertencentes ao fluxo de materiais especiais (OPME), operacionalizando o sistema INPART de maneira adequada e assegurar execução de todas as etapas corporativamente predefinidas;
  • Realizar a entrega de insumos previamente separados pelas farmácias e almoxarifado para diferentes destinos internos no hospital, desde postos de enfermagem até farmácias satélites;
  • Efetuar diariamente o controle de temperatura (geladeira e ambiente) e controle de umidade, verificando a temperatura e umidade nos termômetros e termohigrômetro e anotando na ficha de controle, visando garantir a temperatura ideal para armazenamento de medicamentos e materiais;
  • Zelar pela conservação dos equipamentos utilizados diariamente, devendo informar ao farmacêutico qualquer necessidade de manutenção ou troca destes, a fim de manter os equipamentos em condições de uso;
  • Zelar diariamente pela limpeza e organização do setor de farmácia e almoxarifado, realizando as atividades diárias de forma que a limpeza e organização sejam mantidas, visando manter o setor limpo e organizado;
  • Cumprir e respeitar as normas e regras instituídas pela empresa, bem como as regras dos órgãos certificadores adotados por esta instituição.

Qualificações Necessárias

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Não é requerida experiência anterior comprovada na área;
  • Experiência profissional anterior como auxiliar de farmácia hospitalar será considerado apenas um diferencial;
  • Experiência profissional anterior como auxiliar de farmácia hospitalar no setor de OPME será considerado apenas um diferencial;
  • Necessário conhecimento básico com Informática;
  • Conhecimentos em sistemas hospitalares como será considerado um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar como diarista no horário 07h às 17h segunda a quinta e 07h às 16h sexta-feira.

title: Técnico de Manutenção Mecânica
description:
VEM SER GUARACAMP!

Há 30 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz , autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.

Aqui, a gente tem Sangue Verde — orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono. Cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, percebemos o que precisa ser feito e agimos com senso de urgência.

Fazemos o que tem que ser feito , sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado.

Transparência é Lei : jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito.

Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.

E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos : valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos.

A Guaracamp Disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com Deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99.

Atividades

  • Executar manutenções preventivas, preditivas e corretivas em máquinas, equipamentos e instalações, de acordo com as ordens de serviço.
  • Desmontar, diagnosticar falhas, reparar defeitos, substituir peças, lubrificar e remontar componentes, garantindo a eficiência operacional.
  • Realizar testes e ensaios em equipamentos após manutenção, assegurando a conformidade com as especificações técnicas e liberando para uso.
  • Interpretar desenhos e esquemas mecânicos para identificar falhas e orientar as atividades de manutenção.
  • Planejar e organizar as atividades de manutenção, incluindo a preparação de ferramentas, materiais e procedimentos necessários.
  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos técnicos de manutenção e sugerir melhorias em máquinas e sistemas.
  • Monitorar e manter os níveis adequados de óleo em sistemas hidráulicos e realizar ajustes conforme especificações do fabricante.
  • Garantir a limpeza e conservação das ferramentas, equipamentos e área de trabalho após a execução das atividades.
  • Aplicar técnicas

About CTI

CTI Clinical Trial and Consulting Services is a global, privately held, full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) focused on the advancement of treatments for chronically and critically ill patient populations. We assist clinical research throughout the lifecycle of development, from drug concept to commercialization. CTI is headquartered in the Greater Cincinnati, OH region with global operations in collaboration with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device firms. For more information, visit .

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as main CTI contact for assigned study sites
  • Conduct site visits (pre-study, site initiation, interim monitoring, and close-out) and complete site visit deliverables with quality and within given timelines in Monitoring Plan while adhering to all applicable regulatory requirements, SOPs and ICH GCP
  • Assist with study start-up activities, including feasibility, pre-study activities and site selection
  • Collect, review and track essential/regulatory documents
  • Participate in and complete all general and study specific training as required
  • Participate in investigator, client and project team meetings; may include presentations
  • Create and implement subject enrollment strategies for assigned study sites
  • Ensure proper storage, dispensation and accountability of all Investigational Product and trial-related materials
  • Perform site management activities and provide ongoing updates of site status to Clinical Project Manager
  • Conduct remote monitoring and complete the related activities in accordance with study specific Monitoring Plan
  • Utilize systems and reports to track subject status, subject case report form retrieval / source document review (SDV), regulatory documents, and IP
  • Assist with project-specific activities as member of Project Team Monitoring Plan, etc.
  • Participate in the development of CRFs and other study related documents (subject worksheets, Monitoring Plan, etc.)
  • Perform translation, customization, and review of Patient Information sheet and Informed Consent, protocol synopsis and other study applicable documents as per required procedures
  • Where applicable, provide support to Regulatory Affairs Study Start-up Team in the preparation or revision of documentation for submission to Ethics Committee(s), Institutions Ethics Committees, Regulatory Authorities, Competent Authorities or Institutions Administration Boards, and follow-up the evaluation process until approval is available. Provide regular updates to Sponsor/ Client
  • Where applicable, support in contract negotiation with study sites, Investigator payments and tracking of site payments
  • Manage ISF and TMF for all assigned study sites in accordance with SOPs or study-specific Monitoring Plans
  • Identify an anticipated site issue and implement corrective actions or escalate as appropriate
  • Liaise with Clinical Data Management for data cleaning activities
  • Serve as mentor/trainer for CRAs; may include conducting training/assessment visits
  • Function in the role of Lead CRA for assigned projects
  • Identify and propose process improvements
  • Provide therapeutic area expertise to team members.

What You Bring

  • At least 5-8 years of clinical trial monitoring experience or equivalent experience as determined by CTI Management and Human Resources
  • Fluent in English
  • Bachelor's Degree or higher in allied health field such as nursing, pharmacy, or health / natural science, or RN with Associate's Degree, or 3-year Nursing Diploma with at least 2 years clinical nursing experience, or equivalent experience as determined by CTI Management and Human Resources
  • Previous experience in conducting clinical research studies in hospital setting, pharmaceutical company or CRO
  • You need to be fully eligible to work in Brazil - (São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Rio Grande do Sul/Santa Catarina)
  • Proficiency in Spanish is considered an asset.

Why CTI?

  • We support career progression – We have a structured mentoring program to provide the support you need to move forward
  • We value education and training – We provide tuition reimbursement, partner with universities and colleges to create programs in our field, and have a dedicated training department
  • We value our people – We have never had a layoff in our 20-year history, support a work-life balance, and have provided cash bonuses every year for the past decade
  • Our culture is unparalleled – We've received multiple awards recognizing CTI as one of the best places to work in the greater Cincinnati area, as well as one of the top CROs in the industry
  • We think globally and act locally – We have a global philanthropic program supporting our team’s efforts to improve their local communities (click here to learn more about our “CTI Cares” program)
  • We are looking toward the future – We have had a consistent double-digit growth rate over the last decade, invest in cutting-edge technology, and pride ourselves on our average 95% annual retention rate (a recent report found that the average turnover for CROs in the US was 30%)
  • Our work makes a difference – We focus our work on treatments for chronically and critically-ill patients, who are depending on us to bring these life-changing therapies to market.

Important Note

In light of recent increase in hiring scams, if you're selected to move onto the next phase of our hiring process, a member of our team will reach out to you directly from an @ctifacts.com email address to guide you through our interview process. Please ensure you are applying for jobs directly on our website ( or from our verified LinkedIn page.

Please Note

  • We will never communicate with you via Microsoft Teams or text message
  • We will never ask for your bank account information at any point during the recruitment process

description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Chief Operating Officer (COO) for overseeing the day-to-day administrative and operational functions of the business. Reporting directly to the CEO, the COO ensures the company executes its strategy efficiently, drives operational scalability, and maintains a high-performance culture across all departments.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership & Management

Oversee Daily Operations : Direct and control all day-to-day activities across critical departments, including Operations, HR, IT, and other core business functions.

Process Optimization : Design, implement, and continuously monitor standardized procedures and workflows to maximize efficiency and productivity across the organization.

Risk Management : Identify, evaluate, and mitigate key operational risks to ensure compliance, business continuity, and organizational stability.

Strategic Planning & Execution

Strategy Implementation : Translate the CEO's long-term vision and strategic goals into clear, actionable operational plans and departmental targets.

Performance Monitoring : Establish, track, and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics, reporting performance insights to the CEO and recommending corrective actions.

Growth & Scalability : Lead initiatives that build the necessary infrastructure, technology, and organizational structure to support and manage sustainable company growth.

Financial & Resource Stewardship

Budget Oversight : Collaborate with the CFO to manage the company's operating budget, controlling expenses and identifying opportunities to improve cost efficiency and profit margins.

Resource Allocation : Manage and allocate internal resources (personnel, technology, and capital) effectively to ensure all strategic projects and operations are fully supported.

Talent & Culture Development

Leadership Mentorship : Mentor and guide department heads and the senior leadership team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous professional development.

Culture Champion : Act as a champion for the company's core values, ensuring the internal culture supports high performance and drives overall employee engagement and retention.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Experience & Executive Skills

Experience : Minimum of 4 + years of progressive leadership experience.

Operational Expertise : Proven track record in scaling operations, driving organizational efficiency, and managing complex cross-departmental functions.

Leadership : Demonstrated ability to mentor senior management, lead large teams, and foster a culture of accountability and high performance.

Process Knowledge : Expert knowledge of process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) and strategic planning frameworks.

Education & Certification

Education : Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field.

Relevant Certifications : Certifications in Executive Leadership, Strategic Management, or Process Improvement (e.g., Lean Six Sigma Black Belt) are highly beneficial.

What We Offer

description:
Somos a Strattner

Desenvolvemos a saúde no Brasil, oferecendo inovações que importam, tanto para os nossos clientes, quanto para a sociedade.

Quem somos nós?

A Strattner é uma empresa familiar e brasileira que atua no mercado médico hospitalar desde 1950. Vamos além da tradição. Somos transformação, conhecimento, compartilhamento e dedicação.

Somos mais de 500 colaboradores preparados para levar qualidade e agilidade no atendimento de todos nossos clientes. E há 70 anos seguimos obstinados em viver o nosso propósito de desenvolver conhecimento e trazer inovação para antecipar o futuro da saúde.

A diversidade nos move para frente!

Desde o começo da nossa história, atuamos com valores que promovem um ambiente sempre aberto ao diálogo, onde todas as vozes são escutadas e respeitadas. Acreditamos que poder ser quem nós somos, do jeito que nos sentimos bem, nos ajuda na realização de um bom trabalho, além de criar um maior companheirismo no espaço corporativo e ter motivação para chegar mais longe. Queremos que todos aqui sejam reconhecidos pelo seu trabalho e que todos tenham as mesmas oportunidades. Nós somos diferentes, aceitamos, respeitamos e principalmente valorizamos isso.

Estamos prontos para crescer e assumir ainda mais desafios.

E você, quer fazer parte desta jornada?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar ativamente da construção do orçamento anual (Budget) e dos forecasts periódicos, atuando junto às áreas de negócio na definição de premissas financeiras e operacionais.
  • Atuar como Business Partner das áreas, apoiando gestores na leitura dos resultados, análise de desvios e avaliação do impacto financeiro das decisões operacionais.
  • Analisar mensalmente o resultado realizado vs orçamento vs forecast, identificando variações, drivers de performance e recomendações de ação.
  • Elaborar, analisar e consolidar informações gerenciais mensais, integrando dados financeiros e operacionais para suporte à tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Preparar e consolidar relatórios financeiros e operacionais recorrentes, garantindo consistência, confiabilidade e aderência às necessidades das áreas internas.
  • Atuar no fechamento financeiro mensal, incluindo consolidação intercompany, assegurando qualidade dos dados, prazos e alinhamento com a contabilidade.
  • Desenvolver e apresentar relatórios e apresentações executivas de indicadores para diretoria, com foco em performance, tendências, riscos e oportunidades.
  • Analisar custos e despesas (Opex e Capex), apoiando iniciativas de eficiência, controle orçamentário e melhoria de margens.
  • Identificar e propor melhorias de processos, relatórios e modelos financeiros, visando maior automação, padronização e eficiência analítica.
  • Apoiar o fechamento financeiro e as análises por meio do ERP (ex.: SAP) e ferramentas de BI, garantindo integridade e governança das informações.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação concluída.
  • Inglês nível avançado.
  • Pacote Office avançado.
  • Nível de espanhol desejável.

Informações adicionais

A Strattner utilizará os dados pessoais fornecidos pelo candidato para fins exclusivos de processos seletivos, inclusive em bancos de vagas alocados em plataformas terceiras. Caso deseje solicitar oposição a este uso, ou exercer quaisquer um dos seus direitos, entre em contato através de nossos canais, disponíveis na Política de Privacidade da Strattner ( Não há necessidade de aceitar, trata-se apenas de uma ciência.

Ao participar do processo seletivo, o Candidato tem ciência que poderá acionar à Strattner, a qualquer momento, por meio do e-mail para exercer seus direitos, nos termos previsto no artigo 18 da Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (Lei nº 13.709/2018).

description:
Job description

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

  • Executar as atividades de limpeza em geral nas dependências internas e externas da Unidade de Saúde, procedendo à retirada de utensílios e materiais;
  • Distribuir materiais de consumo nas diversas áreas e providenciar a reposição quando necessária;
  • Efetuar limpeza terminal em áreas contaminadas, de isolamento e demais dependências dos usuários;
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição;
  • Recolher o lixo da unidade em que serve, acondicionando detritos e depositando-os de acordo com as determinações definidas;
  • Manter arrumado o material sob sua guarda;
  • Remover o pó dos móveis, tetos, portas, janelas e equipamentos, espanando-os ou limpando-os;
  • Limpar escadas, pisos, calçadas, banheiros, copas, varrendo-os, encerando-os ou passando aspirador de pó;
  • Arrumar banheiro, limpando-os com água, sabão, detergente e desinfetante, reabastecendo-os de papel higiênico, toalhas e sabonetes;
  • Executar serviços de limpeza da área externa das Unidades Educativas, varrendo ou lavando calçadas, pátios, paredes, janelas, como também, roçando e capinando;
  • Atender às necessidades de Medicina, Higiene e Segurança do Trabalho;

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Fundamental Incompleto;
  • Experiência mínima de seis meses como Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais.

Additional information

  • Local: AP 4.0 (Jacarepaguá, Barra, Recreio e Vargens);
  • Carga Horária: 44 horas semanais;
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

title: MRV Researcher
description:
InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. Our company culture blends people‑first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil — where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

ON SITE, HYBRID - Piracicaba. Language skills: advanced English + Portuguese.

The impact you can make

  • Advance cutting‑edge ERW research in tropical environments, contributing directly to global carbon dioxide removal efforts.
  • Strengthen and refine our experimental design, ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and scalability of our measurements.
  • Elevate the scientific quality of our field and laboratory work, influencing key decisions across the organization.
  • Support the development of innovative MRV approaches that shape the future of climate‑tech science.
  • Build meaningful partnerships with researchers, institutions, and collaborators who help accelerate our mission.

Core working relationships

  • MRV Manager & Soil Scientist – direct reporting line, close collaboration on scientific strategy and priorities.
  • MRV Researchers – daily collaboration on experimental design, data analysis, fieldwork, and knowledge sharing.
  • Field & Operations Teams – coordination for sampling, experiment setup, monitoring, and logistics.
  • Sample Inventory and Lab Teams – coordination of sample processing and analysis, effective prioritisation.
  • Data & Analytics Teams – support on data interpretation, modeling, and integration into MRV systems.
  • External Partners – engagement with universities, labs, farmers, and research collaborators to advance ERW knowledge.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversight and management of the onsite experiments in ESALQ (e.g. greenhouse experiments)
  • Oversee the scientific operations, such as design of experiments
  • Generate, analyse and manage data and samples related to our experiments
  • Ensure quality control checks are carried out on data generated and sample collection
  • Oversee sample inventory management and processing
  • Provide support and research to help the science team strategy moving forward
  • Compare, present and discuss data and research (e.g. recent papers) internally with our science team as well as with leading researchers globally
  • Available to deputise or cover for other members of the science team when they are away on leave or unable to carry out tasks
  • Available to support on field work and infield tasks
  • May lead on certain novel R&D topics related to EW

You can be a Rock‑Star if you have

  • A PhD or at least a master’s degree in Soil Science, Agronomy, Earth Science, Geochemistry, Biogeochemistry, or a related field.
  • Solid knowledge of geology and weathering processes in tropical soils.
  • Fluency in Portuguese.
  • Advanced English, sufficient to present and discuss research within an international team.
  • Residency in or near Piracicaba (SP), or willingness to relocate.
  • Experience ensuring data quality and working with large sets of samples.
  • A deep curiosity for the science behind ERW in tropical agricultural systems, and the ability to dive into details with rigor.
  • An independent, confident, hands‑on approach—proactive, energetic, and driven to make things happen.
  • A fast‑learning mindset, with the motivation to continuously develop both professionally and personally.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to break down complex scientific problems and communicate them clearly and concisely.
  • A collaborative spirit—you enjoy working with others, supporting the team, and actively stepping in when needed.
  • Scientific rigor and high attention to detail.
  • Adaptability and resilience in rapidly evolving field and lab environments.
  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to manage projects end‑to‑end.
  • Clear communication and strong alignment with our mission.

Key qualities

  • Scientific rigor and high attention to detail.
  • Adaptability and resilience in rapidly evolving field and lab environments.
  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to manage projects end‑to‑end.
  • Clear communication and strong alignment with our mission.

Bonus points (not required)

  • Experience with greenhouse experiments, lysimeters, or soil analyses.
  • Knowledge of carbon removal methodologies or MRV frameworks.
  • Prior experience in tropical agriculture or working with field‑based experiments.
  • Familiarity with analytical equipment, geochemical modeling, or hydrology.

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes.
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands‑on, can‑do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change.

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget.
  • Personal development budget.
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance.
  • 40 days annual leave.
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off‑sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity.

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

Roughly 6 hours across 3-6 weeks from CV‑screening.

  • Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation).
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies).
  • Optional third interview.
  • Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed).
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling.
  • Offer.

How to Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese). It may apply to a range of working relationships, including full‑time or part‑time employment as well as independent contractor or service‑based arrangements, depending on the candidate's location and compliance framework. Each engagement is carefully assessed on a case‑by‑case basis to ensure alignment with applicable laws and InPlanet’s global operating standards.

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Executar as atividades de limpeza em geral nas dependências internas e externas do Hospital. Recolher lixo, abastecer material de limpeza e higiene. Manter o material arrumado.

Experiência mínima de 06 meses na área de higiene e limpeza.

  • Ministrar aulas para alunos do Ensino Fundamental I, a partir do planejamento anual, com os planos de curso por disciplina e considerando o Plano de Aula Semanal ou quinzenal, com o uso de atividades pedagógicas orais e escritas, mediação e orientação, proporcionando a aprendizagem.

  • Acompanhar os alunos na locomoção pelo Colégio nas trocas de aulas e ida e volta do recreio, assegurando que os alunos da turma não se desviem do caminho determinado e se desloquem com respeito e disciplina.

  • Acompanhar os alunos no estudo do meio, no horário estipulado pelo Colégio, auxiliando na construção da aprendizagem fora da sala de aula.
  • Estudar o Referencial curricular e participar da discussão em grupo para a partilha do que foi absorvido com o estudo.
  • Analisar e escolher livros didáticos e paradidáticos a serem adotados pelo Colégio, a partir da seleção da Coordenação de algumas coleções de livros, opinando sobre quais livros estão de acordo com as necessidades dos alunos e proposta de trabalho da Instituição.

  • Cursos complementares na área de atuação serão diferenciais.

NÓS SOMOS HEINEKEN!

No Brasil, já crescemos muito e estamos em um novo momento ainda mais movidos pela paixão em sermos a melhor cervejaria para nosso team, parceiros, clientes, consumidores e toda a sociedade. title: AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship in Brazil (Fully Funded)
description:
Applications are open for the AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship, a fully supported international opportunity. The AIDS 2026 Prevention Ambassador Fellowship supports individuals working to expand knowledge of and access to HIV prevention by strengthening their reach, networks, and engagement with the latest scientific research and policy developments. Fellows will take part in AIDS 2026, the 26th International AIDS Conference, held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (25–30 July 2026), which brings together global experts, community leaders, and people living with HIV, both in person and virtually.

Selected fellows will receive support to develop and deliver impactful digital HIV prevention content before and during the conference as part of the IAS “Rethink. Rebuild. Rise.” campaign. This includes funding for content projects, full support to attend the conference in person, and opportunities to connect with researchers, policymakers, activists, and peers while participating in targeted networking and professional development activities.

The fellowship begins after a competitive selection process, with notifications issued in March 2026, and concludes on 14 August 2026.

Key Details and Dates

  • Application Deadline: 15 February 2026 (23:00 CET)
  • Result Announcement: March 2026
  • Conference Dates: 25–30 July 2026
  • Fellowship End Date: 14 August 2026
  • Funding Type: Fully funded
  • Organizer: International AIDS Society (IAS)
  • Eligible Countries: All countries
  • Eligible Gender: Male/Female
  • Target Group: HIV prevention advocates, digital content creators, public health professionals, community leaders
  • Focus Areas: HIV prevention and advocacy
  • Program Language: English
  • Host Country: Brazil

Benefits

Selected fellows will receive:

  • Full support to attend AIDS 2026 in person, including:
    • International travel
    • Accommodation
    • Per diem
    • Ground transportation
    • Visa costs (if applicable)
  • Up to USD 1,000 total for digital HIV prevention content creation:
    • Up to USD 500 for pre-conference content
    • Up to USD 500 for content produced during AIDS 2026
  • Access to global HIV researchers, policymakers, activists, and community leaders
  • Professional development, networking, and visibility through the IAS “Rethink. Rebuild. Rise.” campaign

Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must:

  • Have a proven track record in HIV prevention advocacy or communication
  • Demonstrate digital content creation experience with a minimum of 5,000 total followers/subscribers across platforms (or documented alternative reach)
  • Use ethical, evidence-based, non-stigmatizing, rights-based language
  • Be 18 years or older at the time of application
  • Be proficient in English (multilingual applicants encouraged)
  • Commit to pre-event onboarding and full participation during AIDS 2026

Priority is given to applicants who:

  • Work with or represent key and priority populations
  • Are based in low- and middle-income countries
  • Produce content for underserved audiences
  • Collaborate with community-led organizations or clinics

Required Documents

Applicants must submit the following as part of the online application:

  • Completed application form
  • Demographic information
  • Work history
  • Statement of motivation
  • Descriptions of two digital HIV prevention communication projects:
    • One project before AIDS 2026
    • One project during AIDS 2026
    • Including objectives, themes, target audiences, platforms, and two sample posts
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) with:
    • Portfolio and/or links to recent HIV prevention content (past 6–12 months)
    • Evidence of reach (e.g., screenshots of analytics or engagement metrics)
  • Letter of support from employer (if employed)
  • Letter of reference (if self-employed)

How to Apply?

  • Download and complete the official application form
  • Prepare all required documents and project descriptions
  • Submit your application before 15 February 2026 (23:00 CET)

Submission Email:

For questions, email or visit the official website of the International AIDS Society.

title: Manager, Volunteer Operations
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department

Workforce, People & Culture

Location

Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Operations Manager will help bring together and manage thousands of volunteers across the 8 Host Cities.

In this role, you will support the planning and delivery of the Volunteer Programme, especially in the important areas of attracting, recruiting, training, and supporting volunteers during the Tournament. You will work closely with many internal teams and with the Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The role will work closely with FIFA Zurich to ensure consistency and accountability.

Your main responsibilities will include managing key projects from start to finish. This includes organising volunteer recruitment activities, operational organisation of volunteer trainings, and overseeing the design and set-up of Volunteer Centres in each Host City. You will also create clear operational plans to ensure we meet programme milestones and deliver a consistent, high-quality volunteer experience in all 8 Host Cities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and support the daily operations of the Volunteer Programme while helping deliver several connected projects – including setting up volunteer services such as transport, catering, rewards and recognition.
  • Work on important parts of the volunteer journey, such as promotional events, recruitment, training, and Tournament-time operations. These projects will develop and change as we get closer to FWWC27.
  • Contribute to headcount planning efforts working closely with all Functional Areas to collect, confirm and combine volunteer requirements.
  • Support Host Cities with planning and running the Volunteer Recruitment Centres, helping us deliver a unified Volunteer Programme across Brazil.
  • Create clear, central plans and processes that help teams work efficiently and ensure volunteers have consistent experience everywhere.
  • Build strong working relationships with Functional Areas, Host City teams, stadium authorities, and service providers to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Participation in venue operation planning and assisting in the central coordination of volunteer data capture and management. FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ Job Description.
  • Help develop volunteer policies and procedures that follow FIFA standards and guidelines.
  • Plan and run readiness workshops for the FWWC27 Volunteer Management team to ensure all locations are prepared for operations.
  • Manage procurement processes (including RFI and RFP) for all services needed for volunteer operations from launch through Tournament time, in coordination with FIFA Zurich.
  • Work with Functional Areas to ensure all volunteer-related items are correctly counted, prepared, and delivered at each stage of the volunteer journey. Support Host Cities in delivering their responsibilities on time and in line with the central plans.

Your Profile

  • Education: Master in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
  • Experience: 5 years + Proven experience in leading and managing large-scale volunteer programmes including fit for purpose attraction, recruitment, engagement and tournament time operational tactics.
  • Strong understanding of effective volunteer management best practices.
  • Solid knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experience working with a Volunteer Management System (e.g. Rosterfy) or similar platforms is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholder.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with a proven ability to prioritise tasks, multitask effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi-stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse teams and cultures.
  • Creative, with aptitude to adapt, anticipate risks and remain solution orientated.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on-site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
